name: Insanity decays by exactly 2 every 10 seconds out of combat (#4261)
contract: 500706 tooltip: 'causing you to lose $500728q1 Insanity every $500727t1 sec while not in combat.' $500728q1 -> spell 500728 EffectMiscValue[0]=-2; $500727t1 -> spell 500727 EffectAmplitude[0]=10000 ms (both confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer). #4261 was filed as decay having no implementation, but the current source already wires two paths to it: 500727 is a SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (EffectTriggerSpell[0]=500728) applied by Refresh()'s SetHelper(player, 500727, HasSpell(500706)), so its native periodic tick (AuraEffect::PeriodicTick, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1262) casts 500728 every 10s, whose hit is caught by spell_ascension_cultist_resource::Effect (AscensionCultistAbilities.cpp, effect.Effect==175 && effect.TriggerSpell==Insanity) and calls Resource(player, Insanity, -2, true) out of combat -- AND aura_ascension_cultist_lifecycle::Tick (AscensionCultistAuras.cpp) independently calls Resource(player, Insanity, -2, true) on the same id==500727 EFFECT_0 periodic tick, without ever calling PreventDefaultAction(), so CallScriptEffectPeriodicHandlers (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1237) does not suppress the native trigger-spell cast either. Both paths appear to fire on the same tick unless the player has 706725 (cast only from event 805606), which a fresh Cultist does not have by default. This scenario asserts the tooltip's exact -2 value; a -4 result would mean the two paths double-count, a distinct defect from '#4261 not implemented' and outside this issue's reported scope to fix blindly.

steps.label: Let Refresh() apply the 500727 decay helper aura (polled every 500 ms)
SETUP: 706725 (the decay-suppression aura) is not known by a fresh Cultist
One full 10000 ms decay tick, plus a buffer for step resolution
Insanity lost exactly 2 (#4261 tooltip), not 0 (no implementation) or 4 (double-counted)
